english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the power or right to command, make rules, or impose obligations.

exampleSentences.english: The boss has the authority to decide this.
exampleSentences.traditional: 老闆有權力決定呢件事。

english.note: Use 權力 for the ability to control or influence people, including formal political, legal, or business authority.

exampleSentences.english: People with power shouldn't abuse it.
exampleSentences.traditional: 有權力嘅人唔應該亂咁用權。
